ATL.name: Asa Newell
ATL.detail: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

ATL.name: Keshon Gilbert
ATL.detail: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

BOS.name: Paul George
BOS.detail: George (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Toronto, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

BKN.name: Nolan Traore
BKN.detail: Traore (calf) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.

BKN.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
BKN.detail: Brown has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans due to an illness, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.

CHI.name: Caleb Wilson
CHI.detail: Wilson won't return to Wednesday's game against the Spurs due to a right hand injury. He'll finish with 15 points (5-7 FG, 2-2 3Pt, 3-3 FT), five rebounds and one steal in 15 minutes.

CHI.name: Dailyn Swain
CHI.detail: Swain (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

CHI.name: Norman Powell
CHI.detail: Powell (shoulder) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Spurs,Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

CHI.name: Tobe Awaka
CHI.detail: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

CLE.name: Sam Merrill
CLE.detail: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

DEN.name: Julian Strawther
DEN.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

GS.name: Stephen Curry
GS.detail: Steve Kerr told reporters Wednesday that Curry said he tweaked something in his abdominal area and "had never done it before." Kerr added that the concern level is high, but they will await the MRI results, Kelly Iko of Yahoo Sports reports.

GS.name: Gary Payton II
GS.detail: Payton (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against Houston.

GS.name: Brandon Williams
GS.detail: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

HOU.name: Clint Capela
HOU.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

HOU.name: Steven Adams
HOU.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

IND.name: Aaron Nesmith
IND.detail: Nesmith will not return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to right knee soreness. He'll finish with two points (1-6 FG, 0-4 3Pt), one rebound and one assist across 22 minutes.

IND.name: Tyrese Haliburton
IND.detail: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

LAC.name: Cam Christie
LAC.detail: Christie (ankle) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix.

LAC.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
LAC.detail: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

LAC.name: Brandon Ingram
LAC.detail: Ingram (Achilles) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game at Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

LAC.name: Bradley Beal
LAC.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

LAC.name: Jordan Miller
LAC.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

LAL.name: Collin Sexton
LAL.detail: Sexton did not return to Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks and required stitches to close a cut on his forehead, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

LAL.name: Austin Reaves
LAL.detail: Head coach JJ Redick said that X-rays on Reaves' left heel came back negative, but they won't have another update until he undergoes further imaging back in Los Angeles on Thursday, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

LAL.name: Luka Doncic
LAL.detail: Doncic finished Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks with 32 points (10-25 FG, 5-12 3Pt, 7-10 FT), five rebounds, five assists and three steals across 32 minutes. He exited to the locker room late in the fourth quarter due to an apparent right ankle injury and did not return, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

LAL.name: Quentin Grimes
LAL.detail: Grimes (finger) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

MEM.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
MEM.detail: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.

MEM.name: Quinten Post
MEM.detail: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nuggets.

MEM.name: Richie Saunders
MEM.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

MIL.name: Ryan Rollins
MIL.detail: Rollins (head) exited to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Wednesday's 123-112 loss to the Lakers and did not return, finishing with eight points (3-10 FG, 2-6 3Pt), seven rebounds, four assists and one steal across 24 minutes.

MIL.name: Myles Turner
MIL.detail: Turner has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers due to rest.

NO.name: Trey Murphy III
NO.detail: Murphy (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

NO.name: Bennedict Mathurin
NO.detail: Mathurin has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets due to a right thumb sprain.

NO.name: Trendon Watford
NO.detail: Watford (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

NO.name: Yves Missi
NO.detail: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

OKC.name: Jaylin Williams
OKC.detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.

OKC.name: Ajay Mitchell
OKC.detail: Mitchell has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers due to a left ankle sprain.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.detail: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

OKC.name: Cason Wallace
OKC.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Chet Holmgren
OKC.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

ORL.name: Tristan da Silva
ORL.detail: Da Silva (calf) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Jazz.

ORL.name: Jamal Cain
ORL.detail: Cain (shoulder) is out for Wednesday's game in Utah.

ORL.name: Jalen Suggs
ORL.detail: Suggs (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.

ORL.name: Jonathan Isaac
ORL.detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

ORL.name: Paolo Banchero
ORL.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ORL.name: Noah Penda
ORL.detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Izaiyah Nelson
ORL.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

POR.name: Chris Youngblood
POR.detail: Youngblood has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

POR.name: Vit Krejci
POR.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

POR.name: Ja Morant
POR.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

SAC.name: Precious Achiuwa
SAC.detail: Achiuwa left Tuesday's 107-100 loss to the Magic with a left lower leg contusion and did not return, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

SAC.name: Maxime Raynaud
SAC.detail: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

SAC.name: Ben Simmons
SAC.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

SA.name: Devin Vassell
SA.detail: Vassell (adductor) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Bulls, Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio reports.

SA.name: Tobias Harris
SA.detail: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

SA.name: Jayden Quaintance
SA.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

UTAH.name: Lauri Markkanen
UTAH.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

UTAH.name: Jusuf Nurkic
UTAH.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

UTAH.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTAH.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
